newsitem.title: FRANCE: Jet Services forecasts double-digit profit growth.
newsitem.headline: Jet Services forecasts double-digit profit growth.

text.p: French road and air express distribution company, Jet Services, is forecasting a double-digit increase in turnover and net profits for the 12-month financial year ending March 31 1997,

"We expect to table a turnover of 1.82 billion francs for the period in question compared to 1.57 billion francs for the 1995/96 financial year, with net profits rising from 72.3 million francs to around 80 million," a Jet Services official told Reuters.

"Despite a fiercely competitive market which has engendered a significant fall in the level of rates, we have managed to improve our financial performance and this can be attributed to productivity gains and an ambitious, on-going programme of internal growth which has been largely centred on extending and consolidating the distribution network of our European express services subsidiary, Axor," the official said.

Jet Services is also forecasting an increase in the average daily volume of traffic handled by its domestic and European networks to 220,000 shipments compared to 175,000 shipments in the previous financial year, the official added. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
